levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث بن سعد

notes: «أرسله شعيب بن أبي حمزة» names a different transmitter for the same report (the mursal form): a variant one-link group, never a route
The chain ends at Salim; «أن عبد الله بن عمر، كان يكري أرضه» describes his father's act, so Ibn Umar is not a link
The uncle's words inside Rafi's account («سمعت عمى») are an embedded story in the scene; not stored as a route; the rule that would settle it is not clear here, so this is only a note
